data.title: Add bug dependencies
data.body:
## Goal

Allow bugs to declare dependencies on other bugs, enabling "blocks/blocked-by" relationships.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `DependencyAdded { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [ ] Add `DependencyRemoved { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [ ] `docket depend ID --on BLOCKER_ID` creates dependency
- [ ] `docket undepend ID --on BLOCKER_ID` removes dependency
- [ ] `docket show ID` displays blocked-by and blocks relationships
- [ ] `docket list` indicates when a bug is blocked
- [ ] Blocked bugs should be filtered from "ready to work" views

## Context

When prioritizing work, knowing what blocks what matters. If bug A depends on bug B, I shouldn't start A until B is done.

This enables smarter triage and helps answer "what should I work on next?"

Note: The existing `block` command is for external blockers (waiting on someone else). This is for bug-to-bug dependencies.

## Log

- 2026-01-15: Implemented bug dependencies feature:
  - Added `DependencyAdded` and `DependencyRemoved` event types (already present)
  - Added `blocked_by` field to Bug struct with `has_dependencies()`, `is_blocked_by()` methods (already present)
  - Updated `derive_bug()` to handle dependency events (already present)
  - Created `docket depend ID --on BLOCKER_ID` command to add inter-bug dependencies
  - Created `docket undepend ID --on BLOCKER_ID` command to remove dependencies
  - `docket show` already displays "Blocked by:" and "Blocks:" relationships
  - Updated `docket list` to show "[dep]" indicator for bugs with unresolved dependencies
  - Updated `docket ready` to filter out bugs with unresolved dependencies
  - All tests pass, clippy clean
